protocols.name: Bounded-Tail BF16 Admission
protocols.new_work_frontier: Current-query page-bound and omitted-value certificate tasks; no future query.
protocols.exactness: The stated real bound and rational one-rounding CPU controls hold. Native backend error envelopes and execution parity remain unqualified.
protocols.cheapest_falsifier: A deterministic score-only rule fails on large values, denominator changes, and BF16 rounding boundaries. A stricter protocol first needs a source-backed native envelope, then a complete archived query/K/V admission test.
protocols.retained_question: Can a qualified selective reader remove enough actual reads to beat native TP plus the same generic certificate facility? No physical result exists.

protocols.name: Versioned Historical-KV Lookahead
protocols.new_work_frontier: Committed historical words and addresses can move before the query exists. Current uncommitted K/V cannot.
protocols.exactness: Byte-preserving transfer is semantically exact with valid leases and the unchanged attention path. The toy checks only range and version rules.
protocols.cheapest_falsifier: Native head-sharded TP has no required per-layer peer-KV transfer to remove. The toy rejects uncommitted ranges, wrong depth, and stale page generation.
protocols.retained_question: A named exposed memory stall or real capacity boundary could still favor selected retention/prefetch. This round measures neither.

primary_sources.name: Quest v2
primary_sources.observation: Per-page key extrema supply a current-query upper score bound. The fixed top-K token budget does not certify dense attention output.
primary_sources.limit: The inspected evaluation Python computes full score tensors before masking. No optimized kernel execution or traffic measurement occurs.

primary_sources.name: SSA author source, omitted-tail certificate
primary_sources.observation: Direct generic omitted-mass/output-bound and fallback protocol. The code explicitly disclaims directed-rounding certification.
primary_sources.limit: Primary author repository, not independent validation. The audit transfers no reported model measurement to Ouro and executes no repository code.

primary_sources.name: SoftAct author manuscript
primary_sources.observation: Finite-output zero detection has a prior under a quantized nonlinear hardware contract.
primary_sources.limit: That contract does not establish unchanged native BF16 attention parity. No quantization or activation replacement transfers.

primary_sources.name: Transformers official offloaded KV implementation
locators: 1415-1426 two-way stream ordering and next-layer issue
primary_sources.observation: Known next-layer KV prefetch and explicit stream ordering are direct generic controls.
primary_sources.limit: CPU offload is not a verified peer-paged Ouro adapter. No runtime import or execution occurs.

primary_sources.name: PTX ISA 8.8, CUDA 12.9.1 archive
primary_sources.observation: Local cache-line prefetch and eviction-priority primitives exist. Cache operators do not alter memory consistency.
primary_sources.limit: Primitive support does not prove residency, ordering of unrelated producers, or physical overlap. No instruction executes.

primary_sources.name: CUDA 12.9.1 programming guide
locators: sections 6.2.3.1-6.2.3.8 L2 persistence and shared set-aside
primary_sources.observation: Separate L2 budget/window limits and asynchronous peer-copy facilities apply.
primary_sources.limit: No device-property query or CUDA call occurs. Total recorded L2 is not the measured persisting budget.
